mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm (receiver_id, sender_id, type, content, target_url, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{receiverId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{content}, #{targetUrl}, false, now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, content, target_url, is_read, created_at FROM alarm WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alarm WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = false
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm SET is_read = true WHERE id = #{alarmId}
UPDATE alarm SET is_read = true WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = false
